name: B10-0082/2024 (The Left) – Strengthening Moldova’s resilience against Russian interference ahead of the upcoming presidential elections and a constitutional referendum on EU integration
title: Resolution on strengthening Moldova’s resilience against Russian interference ahead of the upcoming presidential elections and a constitutional referendum on EU integration
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position before Moldova's presidential election and its referendum on joining the European Union, both on 20 October 2024. It warns that Russia is trying to sway the result through disinformation, illegal party funding and cyberattacks. It asks the European Union to keep helping Moldova defend itself, and it asks Moldova to protect free speech and a fair opposition while it does so.

- The Parliament gives opinions and asks for action; no law changes and no money is decided here.
- It affects Moldova's voters, parties and media, and the European Union's support for Moldova.
- Next: the resolution is sent to the European Union's institutions and to Moldova and Russia.
